nodes.label: Compact desktop workspaces
nodes.rationale: - Desktop sidebar: 210 px; top bar: 44 px; main gutters: 20 px. - Page headings: 26 px; ordinary controls: 34 px; table text: 13 px. Small helper text remains subordinate to the record content. - The next-step guide is a compact strip above most workspaces. Today and Products & boxes place its controls in the header, with the highlighted field and action retaining their guidance. - Order, purchasing, packing, billing and user registers keep their filters and pagination in the viewport. Long tables scroll within their region, with sticky column headings.

nodes.label: Sticky register controls
nodes.rationale: - Order, purchasing, packing, billing and user registers keep their filters and pagination in the viewport. Long tables scroll within their region, with sticky column headings. - New order upload uses two columns on wide screens: guidance and format help beside the upload form. The form keeps its original DOM and keyboard order. - Purchasing groups the task summary and quantity totals together. Source files share the export toolbar. All purchasing worksheet columns fit a typical desktop content area; longer worksheets scroll internally. - Packing queue catalogue access shares the page toolbar. nodes.label: Product catalogue worksheet
nodes.rationale: - Product settings use one filter row and a large editable worksheet. Save is in the header and save status shares the pagination footer. Temperature counts are available in the Temperature filter. Repeated temperature rules, grouping explanations, planning configuration and training instructions have been removed from the main view. - Today is a dashboard with summary cards and separate work-queue cards. Cards use two columns on desktop and three on wider screens, with one column on phones. Each queue previews up to three records and provides access to the full queue. nodes.label: Today queue dashboard
nodes.rationale: - Today is a dashboard with summary cards and separate work-queue cards. Cards use two columns on desktop and three on wider screens, with one column on phones. Each queue previews up to three records and provides access to the full queue. Pending/all queue filters remain available; empty queues are excluded by default. The page scrolls naturally instead of using nested scroll panels. - Phone layouts retain their touch controls and natural document scrolling. Print styles retain their original dimensions; compact overrides are screen-only. ## Browser coverage

nodes.label: Responsive touch controls
nodes.rationale: - Phone layouts retain their touch controls and natural document scrolling. Print styles retain their original dimensions; compact overrides are screen-only. ## Browser coverage

nodes.label: Grouped role-aware navigation
nodes.rationale: The subsequent dashboard polish adds subdued stage colours, clearer icon treatments, aligned card footers, readable customer labels and larger clickable summary targets. Navigation is grouped into Overview (Today), Operations (Orders, Purchasing, Packing, Scan box, Billing), Catalogue (Products & boxes) and Administration (Team & access). The same grouping is used on phones; inaccessible pages and empty groups are omitted. Short desktop screens scroll the navigation while keeping account controls available. nodes.label: Synthetic browser layout evidence
nodes.rationale: The Playwright fixtures intercept API requests and use synthetic orders, customers, products and invoices. These layout checks do not change operational data. - Seven registers with 25 records at 1366 × 768, 1536 × 864 and 1920 × 1080: no horizontal page overflow, pagination fully visible, no whole-page vertical scrolling, and records beginning near the upper half of the viewport. - The same registers with one record at 1366 × 700.
